title: People Operations Generalist
description:
WHAT WE DO MATTERS:

At The Knot Worldwide, we champion celebration - and that starts with celebrating our people. Our employees are passionate dreamers, thoughtful doers, and lifelong learners who power meaningful moments for millions around the world. We’re united by authentic connection, shared purpose, and a deep commitment to the global community we serve. Here, flexibility and belonging go hand in hand with high performance. We believe the best ideas come from empowered teams: those who consistently collaborate with intention to design solutions, spark ideas, and drive impact. Our people are at the heart of our success.

Please submit your CV in English.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:

The People Operations Generalist role at TKWW will provide some operational support to People BPs, but with a renewed focus on process standardization, HR systems management, and data ownership. People Operations is responsible for setting the global standards, processes, and policies for all employee lifecycle changes, and the Generalist will play a key role in ensuring these processes are executed flawlessly across all regions . The People Operations Generalist will manage administrative tasks related to the employee lifecycle (such as onboarding, offboarding, promotions, merit adjustments, etc.), but with an increased emphasis on process alignment, systems management, and data integrity. As the "guardians of the data," People Operations is accountable for the accuracy and reliability of employee information, and you will help maintain this high standard by ensuring that all data and lifecycle changes are recorded and updated correctly.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage and execute the end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, promotions, merit adjustments, and employee transfers. Ensure all changes are documented accurately in HR systems, in employee files, in documented employee memos, and aligned with company policies and local labor laws.
  • HR Systems Management & Data Integrity: Oversee and maintain employee data within the HR systems (e.g., HRIS, ATS, in collaboration with payroll). As a key member of the People Ops team, you will ensure that all employee lifecycle changes are accurately tracked and aligned with standard operating procedures. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity of employee data, making sure it is up-to-date and reflects changes accurately across systems.
  • Process Standardization & Execution: Follow and execute standardized People Operations processes for all employee lifecycle events, ensuring compliance with global policies and local regulations. Support the continuous improvement of these processes to increase efficiency and streamline workflows.
  • Collaboration with Total Rewards: Support the People Operations team in areas related to Total Rewards, including compensation and benefits. You may assist with administering benefits programs, ensuring accuracy in pay and benefit-related changes, and liaising with external vendors or partners for benefits enrollment and compensation adjustments.
  • Ad Hoc People Operations Support: Provide general support to the broader People Operations function on various initiatives, including but not limited to compliance projects, mandatory compliance training, and other HR programs.
  • Regional & Global Partnership:
    • Work closely with global People Ops teams to ensure processes and initiatives are aligned across regions. In the absence of a local HRBP or People Ops team, you will be relied upon to handle a broad range of employee needs and act as a key resource for your region.
    • You will have the opportunity to partner with broader teams to provide additional support in areas such as Total Rewards (compensation and benefits), new hire orientation .
    • You may be asked to provide local support for answering employee inquiries, providing guidance on company policies, benefits or other essential information, and acting as a liaison between employees and the global People teams.

SUCCESSFUL PEOPLE OPERATIONS GENERALIST CANDIDATES HAVE:

  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in an HR Generalist, or People Operations role, with strong experience supporting employee lifecycle management processes (onboarding, offboarding, promotions, etc.), HR systems management, and compliance.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • HR Systems & Data Management: Familiarity with HRIS systems and experience with data entry, system management, and reporting. Strong attention to detail and a passion for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of employee data.
  • Process-Oriented Mindset: Experience in implementing and executing standardized HR processes, with a focus on streamlining workflows and maintaining compliance with global and local policies.
  • Regional Expertise (where applicable): Experience working in specific geographic regions with an understanding of local labor laws and HR practices. In regions where you are the sole People Ops representative, the ability to take ownership of various HR functions, including performance management and employee relations, will be critical.
  • Total Rewards Knowledge: A basic understanding of compensation, benefits, and rewards programs is a plus, particularly in how these programs impact the employee lifecycle.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise between employees, People BPs, and other key stakeholders. Comfortable working across cultures and with diverse teams.
  • Adaptability & Problem-Solving: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. You should be proactive, adaptable, and able to problem-solve as challenges arise.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail, especially when handling employee data, documentation, and system updates.
  • Educational Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. HR certifications (e.g., SHRM-CP, PHR) are a plus.

WORK MODEL: This role is fully remote and not tied to any specific office location. While there are no regular in-office requirements, we encourage our remote team members to gather intentionally for key company and team events to stay connected and engaged.

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe you are more than a resume and invite you to go for it, take the leap of faith, and apply for this job if it sparks your passion to join TKWW and make a difference!

WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:

We believe in a wide range of holistic offerings to support our employees so that they can live our values day in and day out. From mental wellbeing, physical health and financial planning, to engaging perks and discounts, we are in the business of celebrating and supporting the Moments that Matter both in and out of the “office”. We offer flexible vacation, generous parental leave and prioritize initiatives that support the growth, development, and happiness of our people.

is our approach to hybrid work. It’s designed to support how we work best: combining the flexibility we value with meaningful opportunities to connect in person. Whether a role is or not, we believe in purposeful moments to come together, build strong relationships, and drive bold ideas forward.

  • For roles, this includes regular in-office time to foster collaboration and connection.
  • For roles not eligible for in-office expectations , we support connection through virtual collaboration and intentional gatherings.

To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have office spaces in Barcelona, Spain; Delhi, India; Galway, Ireland; London, England; New York, NY; and Washington, D.C.

In addition to federal law requirements, The Knot Worldwide complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. The Knot Worldwide expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

Only the data strictly necessary for this purpose is collected. description:
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) is seeking a Transportation Execution Manager to help develop a world class logistics process that delivers goods on time at the best cost. Our team objective is to manage to excellence freight execution flowing through our transportation networks, specifically focused on transportation carrier management, development, quality and performance.

This role requires an ambitious individual. You’ll represent a critical function within our wider Amazon Transportation Operations, as we work to continuously improve the service levels, capacities and costs of the Amazon Brazil Transportation Line Haul. This will help us ensure promises to our valued customers are being fulfilled each and every time.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Transportation carrier performance management, such as on-time truck performance, linehaul impact to customer experience, etc.
  • Identify and develop appropriate performance metrics for each program and ensure consistent measurement and accountability.
  • Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and performing ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
  • Create new and track existing metrics to detect & remove any defects
  • Continual, tactical communication with external customers (Carriers) and internal customers (Fulfillment Centers, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Amazon Logistics)
  • Systematically elevate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered
  • Design short/medium-term solutions to improve performance and quality of the operations;
  • Continuous Improvement Management with carriers, focused in development of larger and more complex players to ensure they will be able to meet demand
  • Optimize procedures, process, and best practices
  • Handle difficult problems/efforts, mitigating immediate risks but working, decide if they can handle or need to escalate
  • Make trade-offs: time vs. quality vs. resources
  • Analyze existing trucking capacity versus forecasted capacity requirements, particularly with the view of supporting seasonal peak times of year
  • Work to develop medium-term capacity with carriers
  • Analyze and improve network design in partnership with Supply Chain teams to meet best in class cost and customer experience results;
  • Ensure right business metrics are prepared for and participate in regular Operations calls, business reviews, MBRs, etc.
  • Participate in the preparation of strategic documents of ATS area

A Day in the Life

As a Transportation Specialist, you’ll be responsible for resolving delivery performance issues that could negatively affect our customers. You’ll understand the unique challenges of the transportation team and manage them collaboratively with other cross‑functional teams. Your motivation and commitment to our customers will ensure that our response to delivery issues is timely and efficient. You will be required to make real‑time decisions effectively, by doing your research, weighing up your options and learning as you progress. The result of your work will be the timely delivery of Amazon packages to millions of customers around the country.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience in program or project management
  • Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
  • Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.

We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to Know our Team

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Spearhead the development, execution, and optimization strategy for growing Agoda’s new & emerging marketing channels
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 4-6 years of experience in Data Analyst position in tech, consulting, e-commerce or digital marketing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Data-Driven Approach: Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations.
  • Proficient in business intelligence tools and data warehouse i.e. SQL, Tableau and MS Excel
  • Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: The ability to tackle complex challenges in a non-linear fashion is essential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.

A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.

  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para aLight !

Seus desafios serão:

  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.
  • Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório.
  • Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.
  • Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.
  • Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
  • Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevSecOps aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas.
  • Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e WebServices.
  • Experiência com integração segura (HTTPS, JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls).
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Automação de testes e validações em integrações.
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise).
  • Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.).
  • Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

Nosso propósito é transformar a sociedade por meio da nossa energia, levando desenvolvimento e bem-estar por onde passamos todos os dias. E fazer parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros, por mais de um século, só reforça a nossa contribuição com o crescimento econômico e social do país.

Somos uma das maiores empresas privadas do setor elétrico brasileiro que atua, por meio de uma cadeia de valor integrada nos processos de geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia para 31 municípios do Rio de Janeiro, além da comercialização de energia para todo o Brasil.

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you’ll play a key role in modernizing a high‑impact geospatial platform by helping transition from ArcGIS to an open‑source stack.   • Work on a 3‑month project

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of experience with .NET or Python
  • Expertise in a modern JavaScript/TypeScript framework (React)
  • Proven experience with frontend mapping libraries, especially Leaflet and/or Mapbox GL JS
  • Strong ability to consume and integrate complex REST APIs serving geospatial data (GeoJSON features, map tiles, and image PNGs)

  • A solid understanding of geospatial concepts (BBOX, vector features, raster tiles, projections)

NICE TO HAVE

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub‑projects.
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement and customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with involved government authorities to ensure smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking within the warehouse and across all venues where assets are provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managing the entry of delivery and collection vehicles into venues during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading services, determining storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside venues, and provision of FFE.
  • Where required, development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP), and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf‑cart pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy in cooperation with tournament management, legal, procurement and all item‑procurement functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking and people resources as required.
  • Managing established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf‑cart provider) and ensuring all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Providing the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration‑management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attending site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meetings and events where an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g., Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creating and managing the Event Logistics project plan, including mitigation and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruiting the Logistics team and providing leadership to the team.
  • Preparing and managing a health‑and‑safety plan.
  • Preparing and managing a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Providing timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Completing the final reconciliation, closing contracts and transferring knowledge post‑tournaments.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics or event operations for an international event.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

Seniority level

Mid‑Senior level

Contract

Job function

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

Responsible for planning, executing, and coordinating activities related to the operations/installation of equipment produced by TechnipFMC for national and international clients. This includes participating in the development of operational installation procedures, in collaboration with the team, to ensure that operations/installations are carried out in accordance with operational procedures, safety standards, and client requirements.

Job Description

  • Participate in briefing meetings with the coordination team regarding the planning of the operation to be carried out, in order to understand the procedures, resources, guidelines, and clarify any doubts.
  • Contribute to the creation of databases for field occurrences and deviations by providing information to the integrated SAP system (S1), suggesting actions and measures to eliminate anomalies.
  • Review documentation from previous operations through reports and study the procedures related to the upcoming operation, in order to be prepared to perform the assigned activities.
  • Participate in the development of operational procedures (OP) for the client Petrobras, detailing the specific steps of the operation to be carried out, aiming to obtain STO validation (client support), which will be shared with other stakeholders.
  • Receive, inspect, and verify the equipment mobilized and demobilized from offshore operations by checking the material lists, to ensure the system is intact and complies with all technical specifications, submitting this control to the client when requested.
  • Perform equipment assembly and testing based on TechnipFMC and client procedures, using the necessary resources to initiate operations.
  • Operate equipment according to operational procedures and safety standards, aiming to meet the demands of TechnipFMC and its clients.
  • Prepare weekly activity reports on SharePoint, detailing the tasks performed each day, in accordance with the established deadlines and content requirements, to ensure the provision of information for time-off tracking, additional payments, and departmental cost control.

Eligibility and Qualifications

  • Mechanical Technician Diploma.
  • Active CFT registration.
  • Fluent English.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Experience and Technical Skills

  • Offshore experience in well completion and intervention, leadership position for hardware scope.
  • Proven experience in installation/intervention (workover) of subsea equipment using EDP, LRP, UEH, and HPU (SCVS/DPR).
  • Proficient in installing equipment such as Tubing Head, Tubing Hanger, Subsea Christmas Tree, Tie-in, UTH, SDH, and others.

Base: Rio de Janeiro / Offshore

Company Values

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

title: Sr. Clinical Operations Lead (LATAM)
description:
Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight

  • Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.
  • Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management.
  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.
  • Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress.
  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable. May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.
  • May be required to manage/oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities, on a temporary or permanent basis.

Project Liaison

  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual/country CRA calls
  • Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress
  • Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout project.
  • Provide project training/mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans and guidelines, and timelines for the study. Ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented.
  • First point of contact for regional CRAs for study-specific questions and issues. Escalates to PM and other functions as appropriate.
  • Support line managers by providing status updates on utilization and performance of CRAs.
  • Liaise with line manager for assigning sites to CRAs following line manager allocation of a CRA resource to the project.
  • Conduct CRA Assessment visits per departmental requirements to assess the performance of the CRA against their monitoring responsibilities.

Study Documents and Plans

  • Develop training materials and study tools for sites and CRAs, including monitoring plans.
  • Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies together with clinical project team.
  • Develop presentation materials for and presents at Sponsor Kickoff meetings, Investigator meetings and Sponsor Calls (as needed), and prepares presentations for Site Qualification Visits and Site Initiation Visits.

Qualifications

  • College diploma/degree AND 7-9 years related experience +continuous training and knowledge/skills upgrading
  • OR Undergraduate university degree (Bachelors or Honors Bachelors) AND 4-6 years\' experience + substantial on-going job-related training

Other

  • Health Sciences, Life Sciences or Nursing specialty preferred, or SoCRA and/or ACRP Certification/Designation.
  • Should have a minimum of 3 years CRA experience, have strong experience with EDC systems, be proficient with MS Office, have strong written and verbal communication skills and highly effective interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrate the following attributes: proactive, detail oriented, task-driven and highly organized.
  • Demonstrate the critical elements of GCPs and local regulations as they relate to clinical monitoring, IRB/EC and Investigator responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated ability in report writing and strong ability to critically understand clinical research documents.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Working Conditions

  • Home-based

Harmonic is the worldwide leader in video delivery solutions, enabling media companies and service providers to deliver ultra-high-quality streaming and broadcast services to consumers globally. Description

Location

Remote – You will be based anywhere in Latin America. US is an option, preferably EST time zone.

What You Will Be Doing

  • The Solutions Architect’s role is to be a technical evangelist for Harmonic’s cloud native broadcast, OTT, contribution, distribution solutions, and Server Side Ad Insertion – influencing and advising the technical decision makers within strategic accounts in our target markets. Primary customers are broadcast television networks, content owners and aggregators (Terrestrial, Satellite, Telco, OTT - Mobile and Internet), TV/movie studios, high-end enterprise video studios.
  • Work closely with account executives and partners to position and further Harmonic’s solutions through every aspect of the sales cycle – presentations, hands‑on demonstrations, RFI/RFP responses, design and architecture, bill of material and pricing. Work with current and prospective customers to generate winning solutions and systems designs, using the latest technologies in video delivery for live and time‑shifted video via traditional medium, or on the latest cloud infrastructure.
  • Ensure technical lead on proposals providing necessary support to meet sales goals.
  • Collaborate with partner vendors in designing solutions to meet customer needs.
  • Configure and test hardware and/or software products, including third party equipment such as network routers, blade servers, and storage systems to customer‑specific parameters in support of customer demos and proof of concepts.

What You Should Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.
  • Have a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in cloud technologies and 5+ years of video experience.
  • Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communications skills. Fluency in Spanish and English required, Portuguese is a plus.
  • Expertise in OTT, CDN, SSAI and associated technologies.
  • Expertise in cloud infrastructure, networking, and video delivery technologies. Analytical and troubleshooting skills in those areas.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership in system integration projects. Strong autonomy, analysis capacity, and sense of synthesis.
  • Good personal relationship skills, organized, with team‑building skills.
  • Cloud and containers environments: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, Mesos, Docker/Containers, and hybrid clouds.
  • Data Center technologies: VMware vSphere and Hyper‑V multi‑tenant data center infrastructure, including Infrastructure‑as‑a‑Service, Software‑as‑a‑Service, Platform‑as‑a‑Service.
  • Networking: SDN, IP routing (RIP, OSPF, BGP), IP multicast (ASM, SSM, PIM, IGMPv1/2/3), QoS (DiffServ, queuing), and switching. CCNA/CCNP is a plus.
  • Digital video system architectures from signal acquisition to delivery for IPTV, Cable and OTT.
  • MPEG‑2/MPEG‑4 (AVC)/HEVC video compression and encoding standards, stream processing, OTT HLS and MPEG‑DASH formats.
  • Interest in customer relations and services. Initiative and reactivity.
  • Broad systems and software knowledge required with significant technical depth in cloud deployment, virtualization, networking, video compression, playout, stream processing, video related applications, and servers & storage products.

Travel (if applicable)

You are required to travel about 30%.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

A pessoa escolhida irá trabalhar no time de Apps, responsáveis pela manutenção e evolução dos aplicativos disponibilizados pela BigDataCorp no mercado. O foco será no BigID, uma avançada ferramenta de validação de identidade e prevenção à fraude. A atuação será no gerenciamento do desenvolvimento nas subcélulas de Documentoscopia, Biometria, KBA, Device Id e BackgroundCheck. O profissional será responsável por maximizar o valor gerado pelas aplicações, garantindo o alinhamento estratégico do desenvolvimento e a eficiência operacional da equipe em um cenário de crescente automação e complexidade tecnológica.

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida das funcionalidades, desde a tradução de requisitos em histórias de usuário até a priorização do backlog com base em um raciocínio estruturado e critérios de impacto, ROI e esforço;
  • Desenvolver e manter o roadmap estratégico das aplicações, identificando e planejando as iniciativas futuras que garantirão a evolução e a competitividade do produto;

  • Consolidar os resultados e dados de produto para comunicar o valor gerado e o alinhamento com os OKRs da empresa, garantindo o engajamento e a visibilidade junto aos stakeholders e à diretoria;
  • Estabelecer e operar um sistema contínuo de coleta e análise de feedback, dados de uso e entrevistas com clientes para compreender profundamente o desempenho e a usabilidade do produto;
  • Utilizar os insights coletados para realizar análises de mercado, identificar tendências e descobrir novas oportunidades ou dores de clientes não atendidas, informando a estratégia de longo prazo.

Requirements

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência em gestão de produtos digitais (ex.: Product Manager, Product Owner etc.), idealmente em ambientes de tecnologia B2B;
  • Elevado senso crítico e raciocínio estruturado para decompor problemas complexos, questionar premissas e validar informações em um ambiente com crescente uso de automação e IA;
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado contínuo, com autonomia para se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias, metodologias e tendências de mercado;
  • Inteligência emocional e maturidade para atuar como uma ponte eficaz entre negócio e tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de software (design patterns) e gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: Jira);
  • Perfil analítico e voltado a dados para fundamentar decisões estratégicas e de priorização;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos, de equipes técnicas a executivos, tanto internamente quanto com clientes externos.

O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos

  • Vivência no setor de dados, analytics ou em plataformas SaaS de alta complexidade;
  • Visão estratégica sobre o impacto e a aplicação de Inteligência Artificial no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e na evolução de produtos digitais;
  • Compreensão de arquiteturas de software modernas e ambientes de nuvem (AWS) para facilitar o diálogo com equipes de engenharia e avaliar a viabilidade técnica de novas funcionalidades.

3 weeks ago – Be among the first 25 applicants

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award‑winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager, you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data‑driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high‑quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data‑driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user‑friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data‑driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end‑to‑end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high‑quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post‑launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES

  • 5–7 years working on technology‑powered products as either a product manager or user researcher
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends
  • Proven ability of building intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs
  • Experience in building subscription‑based products with a track record of driving growth
  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction
  • A history of deep, and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well‑structured, data‑informed, written narrative
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Upper‑intermediate English level

NICE TO HAVES

  • Deep understanding of gaming trends
  • Strong background in app development and design

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Detalhes da vaga

Temos o propósito de identificar em nossos processos seletivos pessoas engajadas com a Nossa Essência. Com o objetivo de avaliarmos com profundidade a sua experiência para as nossas oportunidades internas, solicitamos que atualize o seu perfil.

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo

Supervisionar o processo de faturamento da cia, buscando dar previsibilidade de processos do setor, padronização de processos mitigando riscos e perdas financeiras.

Sobre a Área

Área responsável por garantir que os atendimentos realizados sejam faturados aos clientes, dentro de prazos e regras estabelecidos nas negociações comerciais conforme vigência de TISS. Maximização de produtividade e garantia de qualidade e entrega.

Principais Atividades

  • Acompanhar os atendimentos para que sejam efetivados em receita, dentro de regras comerciais;
  • Acompanhar o tempo médio de faturamento de contas;
  • Acompanhar saldo a faturar e seus impactos no tempo;
  • Contribuir com projetos estratégicos que mitiguem risco de perda de receita;
  • Assegurar a qualidade e segurança dos processos de faturamento, assegurando a excelência operacional da cadeia voltada ao ciclo do recebimento;
  • Contribuir e apoiar com o desenvolvimento de suas equipes, com crescimento pessoal e profissional com visão e formar sucessões;
  • Acompanhar e validar a inclusão de atendimentos em sistemas públicos como SISREG, BPA, APAC e CNES
  • Acompanhar prazos e competências de envio de dados para faturamento junto aos entes públicos

Buscamos Alguém Que Apresente

Formação acadêmica: Administração, Gestão em Saúde;

Conhecimento: em processos de faturamento de medicina diagnóstica laboratorial e faturamento para Órgãos Públicos / Licitações; conhecimento de faturamento de guias SADT, vivência na área da saúde, conhecimento em faturamento de Órgãos Públicos.

Nossa essência e valores

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

  • Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
  • Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
  • Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
  • Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
  • Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
  • Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado;
  • Fortaleçam as relações de confiança da aprendizagem, do respeito e colaboração com as equipes, assumindo o compromisso de influenciar e sustentar o fortalecimento cultural.

Esteja ciente de que promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. description:
Overview

A Iqony Solutions do Brasil é uma subsidiária da Iqony Solutions GmbH, fornecedor conhecido internacionalmente pelos serviços especializados no setor energético, atuando em mais de 80 países em todo o mundo. Desde 2002, a Iqony Solutions do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro, oferece seus serviços nas áreas de Engenharia, Consultoria e Operação & Manutenção para clientes na América do Sul em usinas de geração de energia. O grupo é proprietário de aproximadamente 7.6 GW de capacidade instalada, incluindo plantas Eólicas, Térmicas, Solar, entre outras. Ao lado do investidor, oferecemos as melhores soluções para Engenharia e Operação & Manutenção. Atualmente, a Iqony Solutions GmbH opera mais de 6 GW de terceiros e 7.6 GW de plantas próprias. A Iqony Solutions do Brasil também oferece serviços no setor de energias renováveis com contratos no Brasil que somam mais de 5 GW. A empresa também possui um Centro de Operação e Monitoramento Remoto, situado no Rio de Janeiro.

A IQONY Solutions do Brasil Ltda, assume o compromisso de atuação baseando-se na valorização e respeito aos direitos humanos, rejeitando todas as formas de discriminação, e está comprometida em promover e valorizar a diversidade, inclusão e equidade de tratamento em todos os níveis e processos da organização, zelando por um ambiente saudável e equilibrado de trabalho.
Nossos processos seletivos são abertos para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, orientação sexual, cor/raça, deficiências, religião, nacionalidade, naturalidade, idade ou quaisquer outras características pessoais.

title: [2025] BR - Gerente de TI (Infraestrutura) - L'Oréal Corporativo
description:
Gerente de TI - Foco em Infraestrutura e Business Partner L'Oréal Brasil

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a "criar a beleza que move o mundo"; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Missão:

Em colaboração com a Equipe de TI, Divisões de Negócios e Áreas Corporativas, o Corporate BRM (Business Relationship Manager) e Client Services Lead é o principal Parceiro de Negócios para as Áreas Corporativas e também responsável pela operação transversal de serviços ao cliente no Brasil. Ele/Ela será responsável por manter o engajamento e a comunicação com os stakeholders, compreender o negócio, auxiliar na priorização de projetos, garantindo que os projetos estejam alinhados com uma tecnologia que proporcione o máximo retorno sobre o investimento.

Principais Atividades:

  • Construir e gerenciar a equipe de relacionamento para garantir a convergência e a parceria estratégica com a equipe de parceiros de negócios, incluindo o trabalho próximo com a liderança de CxO como patrocinadores executivos para cada parceiro de negócios.
  • Fazer parceria com a organização de gerenciamento de projetos/programas/portfólio (PMO) para garantir um portfólio de iniciativas saudável e bem gerenciado.
  • Supervisionar o planejamento de projetos de aplicativos, execução, monitoramento de marcos, rastreamento e atualizações de status. Gerenciamento de orçamento e recursos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de funções de negócios e a posição mais apropriada para a adoção da função dentro da organização. Medir a adoção e trabalhar com a liderança Corporativa (Jurídico, RH, Sourcing, Comunicação) para desenvolver roteiros e oportunidades futuras.
  • Focar no valor de negócio em vez de soluções para desenvolver ideias, incluindo conscientização digital, avaliações de risco, continuidade de negócios e requisitos de capacidade de negócios.
  • Gerenciar as demandas internas dos clientes, atuando como mediador entre a satisfação do cliente e a viabilidade da TI (orçamento, limitações técnicas, prioridades, etc.).
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar processos de Gerenciamento de Serviços de TI, como gerenciamento de incidentes, problemas, mudanças e liberações, para alinhar-se aos objetivos de negócios. Eles supervisionam o desempenho e o alinhamento dos serviços de TI, garantem a conformidade com os padrões e SLAs, gerenciam os relacionamentos com os stakeholders e promovem uma cultura de melhoria contínua de serviços usando dados e análises.
  • Estratégia e Alinhamento de Serviços: Garantir que os serviços de TI se alinhem aos objetivos de negócios e às prioridades estratégicas, guiando a estratégia de TI e a alocação de recursos.
  • Monitoramento de Desempenho: Monitorar o desempenho dos serviços e da infraestrutura de TI para garantir que eles atinjam os objetivos, entregando o valor de negócio esperado.
  • Gerenciamento de Stakeholders: Atuar como um elo estratégico, gerenciando relacionamentos com stakeholders internos, clientes e parceiros externos.
  • Gerenciamento de Catálogo de Serviços: Estabelecer e manter um catálogo de serviços abrangente que defina claramente os serviços de TI disponíveis e seus SLAs associados.
  • Fazer parceria com a Equipe de Infraestrutura para garantir o melhor em Gerenciamento de Rede, Gerenciamento de Servidores, Operações de Armazenamento e Data Center, Gerenciamento de Hardware e Software, Monitoramento de Sistemas e Otimização de Desempenho, Gerenciamento de Configuração, Segurança e Continuidade de Negócios, Planejamento de Recuperação de Desastres.

Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Habilidades de liderança para guiar e treinar a equipe.
  • Experiência em Metodologia de Projetos (PMI, PMO).
  • Experiência com Gerenciamento de Orçamento e Fornecedores.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de Infraestrutura.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de serviços de TI.
  • Certificação ITIL.

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Você precisa ter pelo menos 18 (dezoito) anos para se inscrever. Para mais informações sobre como usamos seus dados pessoais, consulte nossa Política de Privacidade (acesse aqui ). O uso do presente site é regido pelos nossos Termos de Uso (acesse aqui ).

Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017 out of a conviction that iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different, Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist – a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug‑and‑play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem‑solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high‑performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest‑growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands‑on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data‑driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e‑commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in‑house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to life, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in‑house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set‑up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e‑commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e‑commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e‑commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast‑paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 2‑4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e‑commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside the box to create new best‑in‑class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, São Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
